case_name: S. P. Watel and Others v State of Uttar Pradesh (with connected appeals)
respondent:
State of Uttar Pradesh (with connected appeals)
Supreme Court of India

28 March 1973
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION: Writ Petition No. 105 of 1969. Petition under Article 32 of the Constitution of India for the enforcement of fundamental rights and Civil and Appeals Nos. 1402 and 1403 of 1969
The Judgment was delivered by: S. N. Dwivedi, J.
1.  These three cases have a common origin and are accordingly being disposed of by a common judgment. The city of Meerut is a municipality in Uttar Pradesh. Plot No. 4635A (old number 5199) is located therein. It has an area of bigha and 2 biswas. It formed part of the zamindari estate belonging to Lala Nanak Chand Trust. The trust is a charitable trust vested in the Treasurer of Charitable Endowments and is managed by the Collector of Meerut through a committee of trustees. On June 23, 1926, a lease deed was executed on behalf of the trust and in favour of one Bateshwar Dayal. By the deed the aforesaid plot was let to Bateshwar Da
facts: The city of Meerut is a municipality in Uttar Pradesh.
A lease deed was executed on behalf of the trust and in favour of one Bateshwar Dayal.
The yearly rent was fixed at Rs. 12/8/-.
The lease was granted for a term of 30 years with effect from June 1, 1926.
A notification was issued on June 16, 1964 under s. 8 of the Act vesting the land in the State.
The disputed plot forms part of a residential Kothi within the municipality of Meerut and is non-agricultural area.
issues: Is the impugned notification violative of the provisions of Articles 14, 19 (1) (f) and 31 of the Constitution?
Is the land in dispute an agricultural area under the Act?
petitioner_arguments: The disputed plot forms part of a residential Kothi within the municipality of Meerut and is non-agricultural area.
The impugned notification is violative of the provisions of Articles 14, 19 (1) (f) and 31 of the Constitution.
court_reasoning: The relevant provisions of the Act are important for this case.
S. 2 in the definition clause defines the expression 'agricultural area'.
S. 17(1) is important for our purposes, and we are quoting the material portion of it.
holding: The issue should now be decided afresh by the appropriate authority under the Act., in the result, we allow the writ petition and quash the Government notification under s. 8 of the Act, dated June 16, 1964 with respect to the land in dispute.
We direct the Government to proceed afresh with respect to the land in dispute in accordance with ss. 3, 4, 5 and 8 of the Act.
